title: Doechii Detonates Herself in the Desert in Explosive ‘CATWOMAN’ Video: Watch
summary: The Florida rapper returned with another installment of Swamp Sessions.
contentText:
Doechii is feeling explosive. The Florida rapper returned with another installment of her Swamp Sessions series on Tuesday (Oct. 20) for “CATWOMAN.”

She isn’t exactly Eartha Kitt or Julia Newmar from the 1960s Batman television series, but this Catwoman’s superpower is rapping. Following last week’s “BOMBS,” Doechii walks through the desert in a pair of baggy washed denim jeans, a Tap Out waistband and a white sports bra.

Related

Doechii Brings Back Her Swamp Sessions for Thunderous ‘Bombs’ Single & Doja Cat Loves It

Lady Gaga & Doechii’s ‘Runway’ From ‘Devil Wears Prada 2’ Makes Its Fashionable Debut: Stream It Now

Megan Thee Stallion Says a Doechii Collaboration Is On Her ‘Album Wish List’ for ‘Act III’

The Swamp Princess meets her demise as she’s blown to pieces by the Catwoman version of Doechii holding a potent bazooka. Changing her hairstyle to an Afro, Doechii struts to the murder scene in black denim, heels and matching sunglasses.

She recalls her 2024 track by the same “CATWOMAN” name and pays homage to Busta Rhymes, shouting “woo-hah” as an ad-lib. Doechii goes on to name-drop actor Sean Connery and his history playing James Bond before letting the people know she’s got a bit of 2Pac’s tenacity in her artistic repertoire.

“B—h, I get around, I got a little bit of ‘Pac in me/ Bottega miniskirt got a pocket for the pocket piece/ You can’t stop me, fire stick like a Taki/ B—h pulled up in a lemon, she need some Tajín/ Doechii had a little lamb, it was black and white,” she raps.

All eyes are on the Grammy winner heading into her anticipated debut album. Doechii shared a journal entry shedding light on what fans can expect with her first LP.

“I spent the last few years relearning Hip-Hop as a student. Studying its language, history & roots. Now I feel inspired to contribute to evolve it,” the TDE rapper wrote. “A mission is brewing inside of me (a responsibility really) to see black womanhood exist at the center of Hip-Hop AND Pop.”

Earlier this year, Doechii connected with Lady Gaga  for “Runway,” which landed on  The   Devil Wears Prada 2  soundtrack and earned the 28-year-old another  Billboard Hot 100  entry (No. 50 peak).
